title: Plux analytics: experiment exposures
description: Experiment exposures per plugin and page (ANL-020).

list.name: organization
list.label: Organisation ID
list.description: The organisation UUID. Row-level security binds every query to it (SRV-022).

list.name: app
list.label: App
list.description: The apps of the organisation with rollups.

list.name: release
list.label: Release sequence
list.description: The release sequences of the selected apps with rollups.

options.content: **Built on the event name only.** The panels count the `experiment_exposure` event. The variant and the experiment are not rollup dimensions yet (Appendix G.2 carries them on the event), so these panels show exposures, not results per variant. Add the variant dimension to `analytics_rollups` (ANL-010) to split them.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT set_config('plux.organization_id', '$organization', false);
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.events), 0) AS "Events"
FROM analytics_rollups r
WHERE r.organization_id = NULLIF('$organization', '')::uuid
  AND r.granularity = '$granularity'
  AND $__timeFilter(r.bucket)
  AND r.app_id::text IN ($app)
  AND r.release_sequence::text IN ($release)
  AND r.event_name = 'experiment_exposure';

panels.title: Exposures by page
panels.description: experiment_exposure events per page over time.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT set_config('plux.organization_id', '$organization', false);
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(r.bucket, $__interval), r.page AS metric, SUM(r.events) AS value
FROM analytics_rollups r
WHERE r.organization_id = NULLIF('$organization', '')::uuid
  AND r.granularity = '$granularity'
  AND $__timeFilter(r.bucket)
  AND r.app_id::text IN ($app)
  AND r.release_sequence::text IN ($release)
  AND r.event_name = 'experiment_exposure'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Exposures by plugin and page
panels.description: experiment_exposure events per plugin and page in the range. Capped at 100 rows.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT set_config('plux.organization_id', '$organization', false);
SELECT r.plugin_key AS "Plugin", r.page AS "Page", SUM(r.events) AS "Exposures"
FROM analytics_rollups r
WHERE r.organization_id = NULLIF('$organization', '')::uuid
  AND r.granularity = '$granularity'
  AND $__timeFilter(r.bucket)
  AND r.app_id::text IN ($app)
  AND r.release_sequence::text IN ($release)
  AND r.event_name = 'experiment_exposure'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 3 DESC
LIMIT 100;
